jobs.prompt: Bookkeeping job: write the pull-request payload for project-swarm 1.42.0 as the single file docs/_swarm/t81-pr-create.json, the same JSON shape as docs/_swarm/t80-pr-create.json (keys title, head, base, body). You are a single-request worker with no tools: return the file WHOLE in the result envelope as valid JSON (escape the Markdown correctly).
